visual.description: A stark black circle perfectly centered on a clean white background.

vo.en: Keep your eyes locked. We're about to force your brain to see a ghost.

visual.description: Distorted digital glitch effects flickering across a dark monitor.

vo.en: Focus on the center while the magenta circles spin. Your vision is already adapting.

visual.description: Extreme macro close-up of a man's eye with the pupil subtly dilating.

vo.en: Wait, here is the creepy part. The color is about to vanish completely.

visual.description: Thick white smoke or fog slowly clearing to reveal a dark, empty landscape.

vo.en: See that? A ghostly green orb just appeared, but there is no green here.

visual.description: Bright green aurora borealis lights waving across a starry night sky.

vo.en: It is the Troxler Effect. Your neurons got tired, so your mind filled the gap.

visual.description: Intricate golden clockwork gears and cogs turning together in a dark void.

vo.en: Comment YES if it worked and subscribe for tomorrow's test, because you must...

visual.description: A man's hand holding a smartphone and tapping the screen with his thumb.
